cleanup: Owned synthetic database removed, temporary private configuration/keys removed, owned test server stopped. Original installation retained.
boundary: Fictional local accounts and mocked Paystack evidence. No hosted installation, real school record, live payment, email, payout or provider account was changed. This validates the tested implementation and package, not live-provider availability or a production certificate.
external_usage: Provider-funded services remain separately configured. No automatic SMS/media/AI/storage metering or provider charge is claimed. Assisted setup creates a helpdesk request for agreed scope and payment arrangements.
